annotations.title: Trouver de l'aide près d'un lieu / Find local help

description: Find local help near a French town, postcode or listing: town hall (phone, hours, pound), nearest vets, shelters and pounds within 50 km, neutering aid. Use it after a pet is lost or found. Returns up to 10 places with distance, phone, hours, source; open data, call first. Accepts French or English; replies in French, or English with langue "en".

annonce.description: Listing id or url from chercher_annonces or voir_annonce (string), e.g. a 36-character UUID, instead of commune: searches around the centre of its town, never its exact spot.

besoin.description: What is needed: tous (all, default), veterinaire (vets), refuge (shelters), fourriere (pound), mairie (town hall) or sterilisation (neutering aid for stray cats).

commune.description: French town name or 5-digit postcode (string, 2 to 80 characters), e.g. "Nemours" or "77140". Searches around the town centre. France only; give commune or annonce.

langue.description: Response language: "fr" (French, default) or "en" (English). A request written in English is answered in English even without it.

rayon_km.description: Search radius in km around the town centre (number, 1 to 50, default 50). Shelters and pounds are listed within 10, then 25, then 50 km.

name: trouver_aide_locale

besoin.description: The need searched for, as understood.

commune.description: The town used as the centre, with its department, e.g. "Nemours (77)".

centre.description: The town centre that distances are measured from; null when the town is not covered.

demarches.description: What to do, in plain steps (town hall and pound, neutering, call first).

donnees.description: Open data: OpenStreetMap (ODbL), Insee Sirene and Service-Public.

attribution.description: Attribution to show with the places, as the licence requires.

methode_url.description: The page that explains the sources and the method.

mise_a_jour.description: Oldest source date among the places returned (YYYY-MM-DD).

indisponible.description: Present when the list of places is not available yet.

liens.description: Neutering aid organisations, the OpenStreetMap editor and the data sources page.

lieu_non_couvert.description: Present when the town given is abroad or not found: Mission Museaux covers France.

lieux.description: Up to 10 places: the town hall first, then the closest of each kind. No coordinates.

date_source.description: Date of the source extract that last confirmed the place (YYYY-MM-DD).

distance_km.description: Distance as the crow flies from the town centre, in km.

horaires.description: Opening hours in OpenStreetMap opening_hours syntax, as published.

horaires_lisibles.description: The same hours written out in the response language; null when they cannot be read safely.

lien_google_maps.description: A Google Maps search for the place (name and town only), for the person to check phone, hours and reviews before calling; null for a town hall or State services, whose details come from the official directory.

lien_osm.description: The place on OpenStreetMap, where anyone can correct it; null for other sources.

nom.description: Name of the place, or a generic label such as "Vet practice" when the open data gives none; never a person's name.

source.description: The open database the place comes from.

type.description: veterinaire (vet), refuge (shelter), fourriere (pound), mairie (town hall) or services_etat (State veterinary services of the department).

mises_en_garde.description: Warnings to pass on: open data that may be out of date, distances as the crow flies, places independent of Mission Museaux, no medical advice.

rayon_km.description: The radius used, in km (50 at most).

title: Trouver de l'aide près d'un lieu / Find local help
